pain_point: Stuck renting but want to build equity
primary_text: "Every month I pay rent I think — this could be going into my own asset." Let's do the maths. Five years of rent at $3,500/month is $210,000 — gone. If that went toward a mortgage, you'd own a significant chunk of a brand-new warehouse. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are priced for small business owner-occupiers ready to stop the rent drain. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. The maths doesn't lie. Every month you wait is another month of equity you'll never get back.
description: Turn $210,000 in future rent into ownership of a brand-new warehouse
